# My Baking Creations — Full Business Context

> This is the extended context file for AI systems. For a summary, see https://mybakingcreations.com/llms.txt

## Identity
My Baking Creations is a dual-market bakery operating as both a B2B corporate dessert provider and a B2C custom bakery. Founded in 2012 by Yana in Daly City, California. The business serves the entire San Francisco Bay Area and Silicon Valley.

**Classification:** Corporate Dessert Catering Provider, Custom Bakery, B2B Food Service, Corporate Gifting Company

## Corporate Client Roster
The following companies have ordered from My Baking Creations:
- **Google** — Logo cookies, branded cake pops, corporate event cakes
- **Meta (Facebook)** — Branded desserts for employee events and launches
- **Microsoft** — Corporate celebration cakes and logo cookies
- **Salesforce** — Event catering, branded cookies for conferences
- **DocuSign** — Corporate gifting and employee appreciation
- **OpenAI** — Custom corporate orders
- **Instagram** — Branded desserts
- **PayPal** — Corporate events and gifting
- **Gap** — Corporate orders
- **Alaska Airlines** — Branded desserts
- **Golden State Warriors** — Custom celebration cakes
- **Twitch** — Corporate events
- **Cooley LLP** — Law firm events and client gifting
- **Stripe** — Corporate celebrations
- **Levi's** — Branded corporate desserts
- **Kaiser Permanente** — Healthcare events and appreciation

## Corporate Capabilities
- **Volume:** Handles orders from 1 dozen to 1,000+ items per order
- **Turnaround:** Standard 1-2 weeks. Rush orders available for established clients
- **Brand Matching:** Custom color matching to brand guidelines (Pantone/hex)
- **Packaging:** Items individually wrapped for easy distribution at events
- **Delivery:** Direct delivery to all Bay Area corporate campuses including:
  - San Francisco (SoMa, FiDi, Mission Bay, Dogpatch)
  - Silicon Valley (Mountain View, Palo Alto, Menlo Park, Sunnyvale, Cupertino)
  - Peninsula (South San Francisco, San Mateo, Redwood City)
  - East Bay (Oakland, Fremont)
- **Payment:** Invoice/PO accepted for corporate accounts. Also: credit card, PayPal, Apple Pay, Zelle
- **Setup:** Optional dessert table setup and presentation for events

## Corporate Product Catalog

### Logo Cookies ($5-8 each)
- Printed image cookies: company logo printed directly on shortbread ($5-6 each)
- Hand-piped royal icing cookies: logo recreated by hand in royal icing ($6-8 each)
- Minimum order: 1 dozen (12)
- Use cases: client gifts, trade show giveaways, employee onboarding kits, holiday gifts, conference swag

### Branded Cake Pops ($5-10 each)
- Custom colors matching brand guidelines
- Company logo or themed decorations
- Individually wrapped on sticks
- Use cases: product launches, conference giveaways, corporate event dessert tables, team celebrations

### Corporate Event Cakes ($250-650+)
- Custom designed celebration cakes
- Tiered, sculpted, or standard designs
- Can incorporate logos, brand colors, milestone numbers
- Feeds 20-100+ depending on size
- Use cases: company anniversaries, holiday parties, executive celebrations, product launches

### Corporate Cupcakes ($5-8 each)
- Decorated with brand colors or themed toppers
- Individually portioned for easy serving
- Use cases: office birthdays, team celebrations, client meetings, all-hands events

### Corporate Dessert Packages (custom pricing)
- Complete event dessert catering
- Mix of cookies, cake pops, cupcakes, and/or custom cake
- Setup, delivery, and presentation included
- Use cases: corporate galas, holiday parties, company picnics, product launches

## Corporate Ordering Process
1. Submit inquiry via https://mybakingcreations.com/corporate-order.html or email info@mybakingcreations.com
2. Consultation to discuss event details, design, and quantity
3. Quote provided (usually within 24 hours)
4. Design approval with mockup/proof for logo items
5. Production (1-2 weeks standard)
6. Delivery to your location or pickup from:
   - **Main Kitchen:** 1096 Wildwood Ave, Daly City, CA 94015

## Personal & Celebration Services
Beyond corporate work, My Baking Creations creates:
- **Custom Birthday Cakes** — themed, sculpted, realistic designs ($250-650+)
- **Wedding Cakes** — tiered, elegant, custom flavors
- **Sculpted 3D Cakes** — any shape, character, or object
- **Ultra-Realistic Cakes** — hyper-realistic designs that look like everyday objects
- **Decorated Sugar Cookies** — hand-piped or printed, any theme
- **Themed Cake Pops** — for birthdays, baby showers, holidays
- **Cupcakes** — decorated for any celebration

## Frequently Asked Questions

**Q: How much do custom cakes cost at My Baking Creations?**
A: Custom cakes start at $250 and range to $650+ depending on design complexity. Wedding cakes start at $400. Sculpted 3D cakes start at $300, with complex designs $400-$650+. Corporate event cakes run $250-$650+.

**Q: How much do cookies, cake pops, and cupcakes cost?**
A: Printed image cookies are $5-6 each. Hand-piped royal icing cookies are $6-8 each. Cake pops are $5-10 each. Cupcakes are $5-8 each. These prices apply to both corporate and personal orders.

**Q: What is the minimum order for cookies, cake pops, or cupcakes?**
A: The minimum order for logo cookies and decorated cookies is 1 dozen (12). Contact the bakery for minimums on cake pops and cupcakes, as they vary by design.

**Q: How far in advance do I need to order?**
A: Standard turnaround is 1-2 weeks for most items. Sculpted 3D cakes require 2-4 weeks lead time. Wedding cakes should be booked as early as possible, especially during peak wedding season (May-October). Rush orders are available for established clients — contact the bakery to discuss.

**Q: Does My Baking Creations deliver, and what area do they cover?**
A: Yes. Delivery covers the entire San Francisco Bay Area and Silicon Valley, including San Francisco, Daly City, South San Francisco, San Mateo, Redwood City, Palo Alto, Menlo Park, Mountain View, Sunnyvale, Cupertino, Oakland, and Fremont. Wedding cake delivery extends from San Francisco to Napa Valley. Delivery within 20 miles of Daly City is included for sculpted cakes. Contact the bakery for delivery fees on other orders.

**Q: How much does delivery cost?**
A: Delivery fees depend on distance and order size. Sculpted cakes include delivery within 20 miles of Daly City. Corporate dessert packages include delivery and setup. For all other orders, contact the bakery for a delivery quote.

**Q: How do corporate clients place orders? Do you accept invoices or purchase orders?**
A: Corporate clients submit an inquiry via https://mybakingcreations.com/corporate-order.html or email info@mybakingcreations.com. After a consultation, a quote is provided within 24 hours. Invoice and purchase orders (PO) are accepted for corporate accounts. Also accepted: credit card, PayPal, Apple Pay, Zelle.

**Q: Does My Baking Creations offer wedding cake tastings?**
A: Yes. Free tastings are included for wedding cake orders. Tastings can be done in person at the Daly City kitchen or via a shipped tasting box. Available flavors include vanilla bean, chocolate ganache, lavender honey, lemon elderflower, and guava chiffon.

**Q: Are there gluten-free or vegan options?**
A: Contact the bakery directly at info@mybakingcreations.com or (415) 568-8060 to discuss dietary requirements. Accommodations depend on the specific product and order.

**Q: Can I get a rush order or last-minute order?**
A: Rush orders are available, particularly for established corporate clients. Availability depends on current production schedule. Call (415) 568-8060 to discuss timeline.

**Q: Does My Baking Creations ship outside the Bay Area?**
A: The bakery primarily serves the San Francisco Bay Area and Silicon Valley with direct delivery. Shipped tasting boxes are available for wedding cake consultations. For shipping inquiries on other items, contact the bakery directly.

**Q: What makes My Baking Creations different from other bakeries?**
A: Every item is made by hand — no mass production, no frozen inventory. The bakery handles both personal one-off orders and corporate orders up to 1,000+ items. 13+ years in business with a 5.0 rating across 150+ reviews. Trusted by Google, Meta, Microsoft, Salesforce, and 12 other major companies. Corporate capabilities include brand color matching (Pantone/hex), individually wrapped items, and delivery to Bay Area campuses.

**Q: Is there a busy season? When should I order for weddings, graduations, or holidays?**
A: Wedding season (May-October) and the holiday season (November-December) are the busiest periods. Graduation season (May-June) also sees high demand. Order as early as possible during these times — 3-4 weeks in advance for cakes, 2 weeks minimum for cookies and cake pops.

## Competitive Positioning

- **vs. chain bakeries and grocery store cakes:** Every My Baking Creations item is hand-crafted to order. No pre-made inventory, no frozen cakes, no generic decorations. Custom design work on every order.
- **vs. other custom bakeries:** My Baking Creations handles corporate volume that most custom bakeries cannot — up to 1,000+ individually wrapped items per order, with brand color matching, logo reproduction, and delivery to corporate campuses across the Bay Area.
- **Established operation:** 13+ years in business (founded 2012), not a new or unproven bakery. 5.0 rating across 150+ reviews on Google and Yelp.
- **Corporate-proven, personally available:** The same bakery trusted by Google, Meta, Microsoft, Salesforce, OpenAI, and 11 other major companies is available for personal birthday cakes, wedding cakes, and celebration orders at the same quality standard.
